_pat_setup: Create a fine-grained Personal Access Token at https://github.com/settings/tokens
Repository access: Only select the repositories Claude needs
Optional permissions (only if Claude needs to write):
- Issues: Read and write  (allows creating comments)
- Pull requests: Read and write  (allows creating review comments)
Rotate this token on the same schedule as your other service account tokens.
Never use a classic token with 'repo' scope — it grants full read/write access to all repos.

github._comment: Connects Claude to GitHub. The GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable must be set before starting Claude.
github._least_privilege: Scope the PAT to specific repos and read-only permissions unless write access is explicitly required.

env._comment_env: Export GITHUB_TOKEN in your shell profile or CI environment. Never paste the token value here.
